fields.DESCRIPTION: Celebrate the rich traditions of Rajasthan with this hand-painted Kamdhenu cow pair, symbolizing prosperity, purity, and divine blessings. Crafted from premium marble and adorned with vibrant Rajasthani folk motifs, these decorative cows beautifully capture the essence of rural artistry and spiritual symbolism. The intricate floral designs in red, blue, gold, and black detailing showcase the skilled craftsmanship of local artisans, making each piece a work of art.
